title: Add two vectors
prompt: Return a plus b. Adding vectors adds the x parts together and the y parts together.
signature: func solve(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	return a
hint: The + sign works on whole vectors; no need to touch x and y yourself.
solution:
func solve(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	return a + b
